Takat chuppi mein badhti hai.
Fortitude endurance ke saath courage hai.
Sahas dar ka virodh hai, dar ki kami nahi.
Khamoshi uljhe hue dimag ko saaf karti hai.
Himmat swarg ki taraf le jaati hai, darr maut ki taraf.
Khamoshi taqat ka sabse bada hathiyar hai.
Grit excellence tak bridge hai.
Shaant dimaag ko bhatkaya nahi ja sakta.
Bolne se zyada suno.
Darte huye bhi karo.
Jo ped swarg tak pahunchne ki chah rakhta hai, uski jadein gehraai tak jaani chahiye.
Jab koi accha jawab na mile, toh khamoshi hi sabse behtareen hai.
Courage contagious hota hai.
Chuppi ek gehri taqat hai.
Lagataar koshish hi taqat hai.
Tum wahi karo jo tum sochte ho ki tum nahi kar sakte.
Grit achievement ka engine hai.
Goals pe atak ke raho—stubborn.
Grit growth ke liye jagah banata.
Himmat sona hai.
Darr shuruat hai, end nahi.
Himmat na chillana—bas khade rehna.
Grit effort ko destiny banata hai.
